title: PEP 9999: Fast cache for the parser

posts.author: alice
posts.text: I propose a global memoization cache in `parser/cache.py` to speed up repeated parses. Benchmarks show a 30% gain.

posts.author: bob
posts.text: I don't think a global memoization cache is a good idea because it leaks memory in long running processes. It would also break thread safety.

posts.author: carol
posts.text: Agreed with bob. How about a per-parser LRU cache instead? Each parser instance keeps its own bounded `ParserCache`, so memory stays bounded.

posts.author: alice
posts.text: Fair points. I like the per-parser LRU cache. Let's go with the per-parser LRU cache and drop the global memoization cache.
